Terranile Digital Infrastructure Ltd. is the parent company behind a growing portfolio of technology, infrastructure, real-estate, financial infrastructure and scientific research initiatives.

Our purpose

Originating in Nigeria.
Designed for global relevance.

Terranile exists to build infrastructure for problems that require more than another lightweight consumer application. We create and develop companies, research projects and systems internally, with a long-term view of their role in the world.

Our work considers how capital moves, how property is transacted, how investment connects to real assets and how computational systems help researchers process scientific information.

Approach

Understand deeply.
Build deliberately.

Start with the underlying system

Examine the documentation, incentives, controls and information that a problem depends on.

Build within a shared structure

Develop distinct initiatives while retaining a consistent long-term approach.

Connect digital and physical

Consider the relationship between software, capital, assets and the people who use them.

Leave room for research

Pursue scientific and experimental questions alongside commercial development.
